slides.title: Pass by Value vs Reference & Overloading
slides.prompt: Pass by reference uses & to modify original variable. Overloading allows multiple functions with same name but different parameters.

slides.title: Pass-by-Reference Symbol
slides.prompt: Fill in operator symbol for passing parameter by reference.

slides.title: Function Overloading Rule
slides.prompt: What MUST differ between overloaded functions sharing the exact same name?
options: Parameter list (number, type, or order of arguments)
slides.correctAnswer: Parameter list (number, type, or order of arguments)

slides.title: Array Parameter Passing
slides.prompt: Fill in brackets to pass integer array parameter.

slides.title: Pass-by-Value Effect
slides.prompt: If variable is passed by value (int x) to function and modified inside, does main's variable change?
options: No, function operates on a copy
slides.correctAnswer: No, function operates on a copy

slides.title: Const Reference Guard
slides.prompt: Fill in keyword to pass large object by reference safely without allowing modifications.

slides.title: Return Type Overloading
slides.prompt: Can two functions be overloaded differing ONLY by their return type (e.g. int fn() vs double fn())?

slides.title: Inline Keyword
slides.prompt: Fill in keyword suggesting compiler copy function code inline.
slides.codeSnippet: ___ int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
